_comment: #1190 — uuid5 파생 골든 벡터. ADR-0158 D4의 refine 멱등 키 `uuidv5(momo.harnessRefi, refinementId)`는 서버(Rust, momo_messaging::refine)와 prime 어댑터(Python, adapters/prime/refine.py)에 한 벌씩 구현돼 있다. 성질이 같다는 말로는 부족하다 — 한쪽이 움직이면 서버가 400으로 잡지만 그때는 이미 프로덕션 거절이다. 이 파일이 그 두 구현이 공유하는 단 하나의 기대값이며, **사본은 없다**: server-rust/crates/momo-messaging/src/refine.rs 와 adapters/prime/tests/test_prime_adapter_contract.py 가 각자 이 경로를 읽어 대조한다. 기대값은 어느 구현의 출력도 아니고 RFC 4122 §4.3(SHA-1(namespace_bytes || utf8(name)), version 5, RFC 4122 variant)에서 직접 조립했다. 값을 고치는 일은 파생 방식을 바꾸는 일이고, 그것은 ADR 없이는 하지 않는다.

namespace._comment: 16 ASCII bytes. Byte 6 is 'a' (0x61) so the version nibble reads 6 while every agent_run.id is uuidv7 — the refinement key space cannot meet the tool-card one at its root. Pinned by value because a 'tidy-up' of this constant in either language silently splits the key space in two.

vectorFields.refinementId: the name hashed under the namespace
vectorFields.charLength: Unicode scalar count — what both sides cap at 200 (HARNESS_REFINE_ID_MAX_CHARS)
vectorFields.utf8ByteLength: length of the bytes actually fed to SHA-1
vectorFields.utf8Hex: those bytes, so a third language can be added without guessing the encoding

vectors.name: measured-rpc-id
vectors.why: 실측 RefinementResult.id — the refine_complete RPC record's own key.

vectors.name: measured-rpc-id-neighbour
vectors.why: The measured id with its last digit stepped. Adjacent ids must not collide.

vectors.name: measured-observed-drift-id
vectors.why: drift_<sha256 of harness_state.json> — the kernel-path id the adapter mints (70 chars).

vectors.name: edge-empty-string
vectors.why: Refused by validation on both sides; the derivation is still total and must agree.

vectors.name: edge-hangul
vectors.why: Multi-byte UTF-8: the name is hashed as bytes, so both sides must encode identically.

vectors.name: edge-astral-plane
vectors.why: U+1D11E, outside the BMP — a surrogate-pair trap for any consumer that is not UTF-8.

vectors.name: edge-longest-ascii
vectors.why: 200 characters — HARNESS_REFINE_ID_MAX_CHARS, the longest id validation lets through.

vectors.name: edge-surrounding-whitespace
vectors.why: The server trims only to test for emptiness (is_valid_id) and then hashes the string as it arrived, while the adapter strips before it derives. Pinned so that neither side starts normalising: a padded id and its trimmed form are different keys, not the same one.

vectors.name: edge-longest-hangul
vectors.why: 200 characters / 586 bytes — the cap is counted in characters, not bytes, on both sides.
